resources.string: Shows your current or next downtime window.

During your scheduled downtime window, Bedrock watches which app comes to the front and blocks it if it is not on your allowed list. Inside the few social apps you choose, it also checks the screen layout to tell an endless feed apart from your messages, so it can block the feed and leave the rest of the app working. It never reads message text, captions, or anything you type; nothing it reads is stored or sent anywhere. It does nothing outside your downtime window.
